name: prototyping
description: Prototyping skills for UI canvas workflows, component exploration, and design-to-code handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Create, inspect, and ship UI prototypes with MagicPath.
interface.longDescription: Prototyping packages MagicPath's agent skill for multiplayer UI canvas workflows. It lets Codex search and preview MagicPath components, inspect and install UI source, create canvas components from code, apply design-system themes, and bring existing repository UI into MagicPath projects.
defaultPrompt: Build an interactive dashboard in MagicPath.
Bring the sidebar from my repo into MagicPath.
